envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login email step

TD-CS-062-001.name: Valid Process Order with All Quality Requirements Met
TD-CS-062-001.expectedOutcome: Process order technically completed; status updated to TECO; stock remains QI; audit log created

TD-CS-062-NEG-001.name: Process Order with Open Deviations
TD-CS-062-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: TECO blocked; system lists open deviation ID; order status remains Released

TD-CS-062-NEG-002.name: Process Order with Missing IPC Results

data.expectedErrorMissingIPC: Technical Completion blocked. Missing in-process control results for operation [OPERATION], characteristic [CHARACTERISTIC]

TD-CS-062-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: TECO blocked; system lists missing IPC operation and characteristic; order status remains Released

TD-CS-062-NEG-003.name: Process Order with Unsigned Batch Record Sections

data.expectedErrorUnsignedBR: Technical Completion blocked. Unsigned batch record sections: [SECTION_NAME]

TD-CS-062-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: TECO blocked; system lists unsigned batch record section; order status remains Released

TD-CS-062-ERR-001.name: Non-Existent Process Order Number
TD-CS-062-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Order not found; TECO action not accessible

TD-CS-062-ERR-002.name: User Without TECO Authorization

data.expectedErrorNoAuth: You are not authorized to execute Technical Completion

TD-CS-062-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System displays authorization error; TECO action not executed; order status remains Released

TD-CS-062-EDGE-001.name: Process Order with Zero Open Deviations (Lower Boundary Valid)
TD-CS-062-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: TECO successful; order status updated to TECO; boundary 0 is valid

TD-CS-062-EDGE-002.name: Process Order with Exactly One Open Deviation (Lower Boundary Invalid)
TD-CS-062-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: TECO blocked; system lists single open deviation; boundary 1 is invalid

TD-CS-062-EDGE-003.name: Process Order Already Technically Completed
TD-CS-062-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Duplicate TECO blocked or prevented; order status remains TECO; no duplicate audit log entry

TD-CS-062-INT-001.name: Stock Status Remains QI After TECO (MM Integration)
TD-CS-062-INT-001.expectedOutcome: TECO successful; stock status remains QI (does NOT auto-transition to UR)

TD-CS-062-INT-002.name: Open Deviations from QM Deviation Management Block TECO
TD-CS-062-INT-002.expectedOutcome: TECO blocked by QM deviation; integration between PP and QM validated

TD-CS-062-INT-003.name: Missing IPC Results from QM In-Process Control Block TECO

data.expectedErrorQMIPCInt: Technical Completion blocked. Missing in-process control results for operation [OPERATION], characteristic [CHARACTERISTIC]

TD-CS-062-INT-003.expectedOutcome: TECO blocked by missing QM IPC results; integration between PP and QM IPC validated

TD-CS-062-INT-004.name: Unsigned Batch Record Sections from e-Signature Module Block TECO

data.expectedErrorESigInt: Technical Completion blocked. Unsigned batch record sections: [SECTION_NAME]

TD-CS-062-INT-004.expectedOutcome: TECO blocked by unsigned e-Signature batch record; integration between PP and e-Signature validated

TD-CS-062-INT-005.name: QM Inspection Lot Status Unaffected by TECO
TD-CS-062-INT-005.expectedOutcome: TECO successful; inspection lot status remains unchanged (CRTD or REL); integration between PP and QM Inspection Lot validated
